facts.text: Jolene expressed appreciation for Deborah's advice on self-care.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Deb. Your words really mean something to me. I'll keep remembering to prioritize self-care.

facts.text: Deborah emphasized the importance of self-care for maintaining energy to help others.

evidence.quote: Looking out for ourselves gives us the energy to help others.

facts.text: Deborah referenced the saying 'Can't pour from an empty cup' to illustrate the importance of self-care.

evidence.quote: It's like they say - 'Can't pour from an empty cup.'

facts.text: Jolene acknowledged that self-care is a healthy habit.

evidence.quote: This is a great healthy habit!
